description: This file contains Jetpack Compose utility functions for tracking performance metrics and jank (UI lag) in an Android app, specifically related to scrollable components and performance measurement state management.

methods.name: rememberMetricsStateHolder
methods.description: Remembers and retrieves the PerformanceMetricsState.Holder for the current LocalView, updating when the view changes.

methods.name: TrackJank
methods.description: Tracks jank (performance issues) by executing a suspend reportMetric function whenever the metrics state or specified keys change.

methods.name: TrackDisposableJank
methods.description: Tracks jank with cleanup, re-invoking reportMetric with DisposableEffectScope when keys change.

methods.name: TrackScrollJank
methods.description: Tracks jank during scroll events on a scrollable component, updating performance state accordingly.
